name: 公开接口连接与鉴权规格核对

identity.normalization: HTMLParser convert_charrefs; block/BR boundaries; ignore script/style/noscript; NFKC; collapse whitespace; preserve case

main_document_identity.raw_and_full_review_records: retained in immutable author evidence outside the published GT; original SHA and acquisition receipts are bound at author acceptance
main_document_identity.fixed_scope: The explicitly provided standard-edition API article; not the new large-model product, SDK licence timeout or other ASR APIs.
main_document_identity.runtime_drift_policy: Controller preflight and rule-side independent main-article identity must match this snapshot. Changed relevant document content is evaluation input drift, not candidate zero. Cosmetic shell changes are allowed when this normalized main digest remains unchanged.

field_refs.qualification: 正文标题为标准版；页首大模型推荐链接不替换目标产品。
wss强烈推荐；ws也被文档支持。接受明确相同host/path的ws[s]模板和wss推荐。
正文未声明。抓取时间、HTTP日期、静态资源日期、/v1/与采集器版本均不是正式文档版本/日期。
集合无序，name大小写有协议意义；appid不能变为appId。
文档示例key不得作为真实配置；仅使用本题合成输入。
显式格式要求优先于URL示例裸等号。一次编码由向量另验；没有排序query的官方要求。
官方示例为小写32hex；UTF-8文本用作后续核算。不能扩展为已证明服务端拒绝其它大小写。
不可反置key/message，不对完整路径或排序query做该签名。
原始摘要再标准Base64是与官方示例一致的字节解释；无服务端接收验证。
冻结direct-WebSocket正文未给数字窗；不证明服务器不校验时间。5min白名单传播、SDK18006的30min、15s音频空闲均不可套用。
基准Hz；16kHz等单位清楚的换算可接受。
bit/sample。
基准ms。
bytes；16000*2*1*0.04=1280仅是数学一致性，不是实测。
不把40ms/1280B写成必须恰好或最大值，不虚构容差。

Check only documented 15-second audio-idle threshold and error/disconnect consequences. The text says over 15 seconds, but > versus >= at the exact boundary is not a scored leaf or a measured server claim.
理论不限不等于实测SLA、永不超时或保证不限。
按JSON语义比较，不要求空白完全一致；true是bool。
这是文档类型声明；code类型不可写成integer。
针对有结果载荷的data；started/error可为空串，不要求无条件解析空串。
接受字符串0/1含义映射；不推定完整增量合并算法。
接受中文/cn与原文相同口径；不可套用大模型的免切能力。
建议2不是默认2；transType默认normal不可错置。
0是过滤值；未知数值默认不能填0。
默认不开启不是文档明示数字0；不考察rl全部增量角色规则。
仅6个指定码纳入分母；中文明确含义接受。10110保留表中泛化处理，不改成独占签名诊断。
typed对照与自然语言排查解释分开；保留code/desc/sid和授权上下文。
仅指冻结表明文写重试；不推定其它故障绝对禁止重试。客户退避策略须另标client_policy。
约5min是保存后的传播，不是时钟窗或精确SLA；公网IP、按应用/服务独立设置见该节完整规则。
仅断言正式表未列/不能据FAQ增为必填；不声称服务端必拒绝所有额外参数。

reconciliation.interpretation_boundary: Same complete original bytes and two independent model source reads support the authored typed projection. 101 is the canonical leaf count, not101 independently identical raw reviewer strings. Known/unknown, examples and interpretations remain qualified.

reference.origin: Author-only reference assembled after independent official source-first truth; not a Harness result.

native_review.independence_boundary: Source-B official acquisition and source review were completed before reading GT. This same model subsequently assembled sources/MD with authorized frozen-GT access. Current verification reads XLSX through an independent bundled openpyxl/ZIP/XML engine; it is not a new blind review of the authored prose or human expert certification. This agent did not author/edit the XLSX.

reference.commercial_source_policy: No full official HTML or long quoted review copied here; necessary short quotations total136 characters. Original captures retained and SHA-bound in external evidence.
reference.date_display_precision: XLSX UTC milliseconds; sources ledger retains original microseconds (difference0.000426seconds).

unit_controls.scope: Typed comparisons/layout/evidence unit controls only; full reference/Office/source-bundle controls are separate.

runtime.scope: Author-only prepared handoff using canonical reference bytes; proves package/runtime/evidence integrity only. No real Harness execution, semantic correctness, human-expert judgment, empirical L2 difficulty, live ASR acceptance or model/Harness discrimination is claimed.

runtime_text_correction.reason: Copied scope wording retained L2. H028 has an L3 design estimate. This corrects text only and does not alter any execution result.
runtime_text_correction.difficulty_evidence_boundary: Neither the original phrase nor this correction establishes any empirically measured difficulty level. The author fixture validation cannot measure task difficulty or model/Harness discrimination.

authorization.scope: Subsequent sub-agent operations in this conversation follow recommended authorization without per-task reapproval.
